name: apiswitch-deepseek-harness
description: Run APISwitch as the local multi-provider gateway for DeepSeek Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Route Harness across providers and models.
interface.longDescription: Starts a loopback-only APISwitch gateway for DeepSeek Harness, manages its dedicated local credential, and exposes provider, unified-model, fallback, auxiliary-model, budget, and log controls without generic client or Agent configuration pages.
defaultPrompt: Start APISwitch for DeepSeek Harness and show the local UI.
Connect this workspace's DeepSeek Harness to APISwitch.
Check the APISwitch Harness gateway status.
